Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the gathered information by declaring "post-punk" as the shared genre, despite INXS not being categorized as post-punk on the cited page. This overemphasized a subgenre from Tappi Tíkarrass and ignored the clear primary overlap: both are rock bands (with Tappi Tíkarrass as punk rock/post-punk and INXS listed with multiple rock subgenres). This mismatch led to the wrong final answer, instead of the correct shared genre "rock."
